# EVA

**Category:** ViT · **Code:**
[`timm/models/eva.py`](https://github.com/huggingface/pytorch-image-models/blob/main/timm/models/eva.py) ·
**Architectures:** 65 · **Pretrained weights:** 83 (28 with ImageNet-1k results)

EVA and EVA-02 Vision Transformers and other ViT variants sharing the `Eva` class, with rotary position embeddings
(RoPE), SwiGLU MLPs and related additions. The module also holds the Perception Encoder (PE), ROPE-ViT, DINOv3,
LingBot-Vision and Sapiens2 models and `timm` original ViT configs with RoPE.

## Papers

* [EVA: Exploring the Limits of Masked Visual Representation Learning at Scale](https://arxiv.org/abs/2211.07636)
* [EVA-02: A Visual Representation for Neon Genesis](https://arxiv.org/abs/2303.11331)
* [EVA-CLIP: Improved Training Techniques for CLIP at Scale](https://arxiv.org/abs/2303.15389)
* [Perception Encoder: The best visual embeddings are not at the output of the
  network](https://arxiv.org/abs/2504.13181)
* [Rotary Position Embedding for Vision Transformer](https://arxiv.org/abs/2403.13298)
* [DINOv3](https://arxiv.org/abs/2508.10104)
* [Vision Pretraining for Dense Spatial Perception](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.05247)
* [Sapiens2](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.21681)

## Usage

See the [Quickstart](../quickstart) for loading pretrained weights, image preprocessing and fine-tuning, and [Feature
Extraction](../feature_extraction) for using the models as backbones.

```py
>>> import timm
>>> model = timm.create_model('eva02_small_patch14_336.mim_in22k_ft_in1k', pretrained=True)
>>> data_config = timm.data.resolve_model_data_config(model)
```

| [`set_grad_checkpointing()`](../model_api#training-hooks) | ✓ |
| [Layer-wise LR decay (`group_matcher()`)](../model_api#training-hooks) | ✓ |
| [`reset_classifier()`](../model_api#classifier) | ✓ |

✓ supported, ✓ (square) works for square sizes only, ✗ not supported, – not needed (the model already accepts any input
size). Checked by running each feature on a randomly initialized model (`Eva` with `vit_tiny_patch16_dinov3_qkvb` at
256), other architectures of the same class are expected to behave the same. See the [Model API](../model_api) page for
details.

## Pretrained weights

Top-1 is ImageNet-1k validation accuracy from
[`results-imagenet.csv`](https://github.com/huggingface/pytorch-image-models/blob/main/results/results-imagenet.csv) at
the listed eval size, - if the weight has no ImageNet-1k result (e.g. pretraining or image-text weights). Classes is the
size of the pretrained classifier, none for weights without one.

Weights are grouped by source: the paper or origin given in the pretrained config, else a Hub organization other than
`timm`, else the first part of the pretrained tag (`architecture.tag`). Sources with a single weight are listed under
other.
